claims.statement: Andrew Carlson recalled seeing Tom Allen fight Mike McCoole down the river, in the days of steamboats.
claims.excerpt: saw Tom Allen and Mike McCoole fight down the river in the good old days

claims.statement: Charley Gallagher beat Tom Allen in three rounds somewhere near Chester, Illinois, as Andrew Carlson recalled.
claims.excerpt: Charley Gallaghefdoup Tom Allen in three terrific rounds somewhere near Chester, Il.

fights.excerpt: saw Tom Allen and Mike McCoole fight down the river in the good old days
fights.notes: No date, result or place beyond 'down the river'. Article 890 gives a separate 1873 Allen-McCoole bout that Allen won; this may or may not be the same bout.

fights.excerpt: Charley Gallaghefdoup Tom Allen in three terrific rounds somewhere near Chester, Il.
fights.notes: The verb is garbled in the OCR ('Gallaghefdoup'); read as 'do up' (beat), as the hint has it. Low confidence.

notes: Carlson's recollections of the old days. The rest of the quote is his general remark on prize fighting, which does not concern Allen.
